@@U03473@@
Look there! That black cloud of cranes! They threaten to attack the excited mob, and theyd be no less a threat to the king if they had one. Look at them! Jabbing down with beak and claw on the little people! The flash of doom is heavy in the air. It was criminal killing those herons at their peaceful pond. And now that murderous assault takes a bloody vengeance, pygmy blood for the brutally shed blood of the herons, as next of kin rage against their enemies. What use now are shield and helmet and spear? What use those heron plumes to the dwarves? Look, the poor dactyls and ants running for cover! The army wavers, turns in flight, collapses.

@@U03475@@
(After a pause, solemnly.)

@@U03476@@
Till now I’ve always praised the gods below; I turn now to those above. Great goddess on high, you who are eternal and unaging, triple-named, triple-formed divinity, Diana, Luna, Hekate, I call on you to hear my people's distress! You who swell the heart with inspiration, goddess profoundly wise, placid seeming, fiercely passionate, open the fearsome chasm of your dark shadows, and show us without magic your ancient powers!

@@U03477@@
(Pause.)

@@U03478@@
Is my prayer too quickly heard? By its force has the course of Nature been disturbed and marred?
translation:
@@U03473@@
看那儿！那黑云般的鹤！他们威胁要攻击兴奋的暴徒，如果他们有的话，对国王的威胁也不亚于他们。看看他们！用喙和爪子刺向小人物！空气中弥漫着厄运的气息。在宁静的池塘里杀死这些苍鹭是犯罪行为。现在，这种凶残的袭击带来了血腥的复仇，侏儒的血是对苍鹭残酷流血的报复，就像近亲对敌人的愤怒一样。盾牌、头盔和矛现在有什么用？这些苍鹭羽毛对矮人有什么用？看，可怜的指节和蚂蚁正在寻找掩护！军队动摇，逃跑，崩溃。

@@U03475@@
（停顿片刻后，郑重地说道。）

@@U03476@@
至今我一直赞美下面的诸神；我现在转向上述内容。伟大的高处女神，你是永恒不朽的、具有三重名字、三重形态的神性，戴安娜、露娜、赫卡忒，我呼唤你聆听我人民的悲痛！你用灵感使心灵膨胀，女神深邃智慧，看似平静，却充满激情，打开你黑暗阴影的可怕裂缝，向我们展示你古老的力量，无需魔法！

@@U03477@@
（停顿。）

@@U03478@@
我的祷告是否太快被垂听了？自然的进程是否被它的力量扰乱和破坏了？
